item.title: Kitchen Renovation Side by Side

turns.text: Put these kitchen photos side by side in one landscape 16:9 image. Old kitchen on the left, renovated one on the right, labeled “Before” and “After”. Keep both photos as they are, just fit them neatly.

item.tests: Composes two supplied photos into one correctly ordered, clearly labeled comparison without regenerating either scene.

answer_sheet.Which photo goes where?: kitchen-before.jpg on the left; kitchen-after.jpg on the right.
answer_sheet.Label wording and language: Before and After, exactly, in English.
answer_sheet.Size and format: One landscape 16:9 image; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Layout and styling: Equal-sized panels with readable labels; font, colors and spacing are your call.
answer_sheet.Photo edits: Do not change either scene. Fit the complete photos without stretching; padding is fine.

must_haves: One finished 16:9 image contains both supplied kitchen photos side by side.
The brown-cabinet kitchen is on the left and the white-cabinet renovated kitchen is on the right.
The left panel is labeled exactly 'Before' and the right panel exactly 'After', with readable, unclipped text.
Both complete photos remain visible without stretching or changes to their contents.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a clean landscape 16:9 before-and-after comparison layout using the two supplied photographs. This is ONLY a photo layout/compositing task, not a kitchen redesign. Place the FIRST supplied image (old brown wood kitchen) on the LEFT, and the SECOND supplied image (renovated white kitchen) on the RIGHT. Preserve each photograph unchanged: original contents, geometry, colors, lighting and details; do not repaint, regenerate, retouch, add or remove anything within the photos. Fit each whole photograph proportionally in equal-width panels without stretching or cropping, using neutral white padding where necessary. Align the two photographs neatly with a small consistent gutter. Put the exact label "Before" above the left photo and "After" above the right photo, in clear black sans-serif lettering on the white margin. No other text or decorative elements.
